subject: [PATCH v5 06/19] selftests/mm: stop khugepaged during the MADV_COLLAPSE cases

2026-09-08.patch_summary: This patch modifies the selftests/mm/khugepaged.c file to stop khugepaged during MADV_COLLAPSE cases by clearing per-order controls in addition to global controls. This is necessary because khugepaged was interfering with the test cases, causing them to fail due to unexpected page collapses. The patch sets the per-order controls to 'inherit' instead of 'never', allowing MADV_COLLAPSE on shmem to still find an order to build pages. This change fixes a problem introduced by a previous patch and ensures that the test cases run correctly.
